lead_html: Hijaz sounds dark and a little exotic. Start with the first three cards: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
alias_html: Saraz Handpans describes C# Hijaz as F# harmonic minor with a C#3 centre note.
history_html: Hijaz is a harmonic minor scale: a minor scale with a raised seventh. The raised seventh makes a major chord that works well in progressions. Played from a different root it can also be heard as Phrygian Dominant. Saraz Handpans says the scale is common in Middle Eastern, Arabic, Flamenco and classical music, and in many film scores, and calls its mood suspenseful, mysterious and exotic. On the handpan, Saraz Handpans says Hijaz was first popularised by Panart on the first generation Hang.
og_description: C# Hijaz 9 handpan chords: the first three chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
